description: This file contains the source code for the 'Upgrade' controller class in the OpenCart admin tool module. It implements functionalities related to upgrading the OpenCart system, including checking for the latest version, downloading updates, and installing new versions.

classes.name: Upgrade
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling the upgrade process of OpenCart, including checking versions, downloading updates, and applying patches.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that handles the upgrade page, preparing data including current and latest version information, and rendering the upgrade view.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Method to download the latest OpenCart version ZIP file, verify download, and prepare for unzipping and installation.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Method to install a specific version of OpenCart from downloaded ZIP, extracting files, and updating system.
